Minutes of the Committee Meeting, 8 October 2026
The meeting opened at 7.30 pm and the chair welcomed the new members. The minutes of the September meeting were approved without changes.
Water supply. The committee reviewed the repairs to the main tank and agreed that:
(a) the new pump will be installed before the first frost;
(b) two taps will be replaced in the lower field, namely
(ii) the tap by the compost bins;
Waiting list. There are now 23 households waiting for a plot.
Winter rules. The notice about bonfires will be posted on the gate.
The treasurer reported a balance of £2,140 and no unpaid invoices. Rents for the next year will stay at the current level.

ActionOwnerDueOrder the new pump and arrange a fitterWater officer30 OctoberReplace the two taps in the lower fieldTwo plot representatives15 NovemberPost the bonfire notice and update the websiteSecretary12 OctoberWrite to the households at the top of the waiting listChair31 October
The meeting closed at 9.05 pm and the next meeting will be held on 12 November.
